name: Entity Auto Term
description: Automatically creates a taxonomy term mirroring an entity's title when the entity is created, keeping term and entity in sync.
project_description:
The Entity Auto Term module provides the functionality that when a entity is

created, a taxonomy term is generated automatically using its title in any

associated vocabularies. 

 This is a similar module to NAT ( https://drupal.org/project/nat ) but it is built for Drupal 8 and will work with all entities.

 

It currently works with nodes but this won’t be to difficult to add the other entity types 

 Thanks to University of Surrey ( https://surrey.ac.uk ) for helping make this possible as this module was required for their project.
